556:t_4:32.en:
$$かなめ$$
「This is... the world I wished for.」

556:t_4:33.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「No... a world like this, with nothing in it...!」

556:t_4:34.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...At first, I tried to go back eighteen years and wish for a peaceful world with no fighting, too.」

556:t_4:35.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If I had, I'd have lived happily with my family, met him, an ordinary high school student... $$相良$$, and fallen in love...」

556:t_4:36.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But, you know... the him in that world surely has no scar on his cheek...」

556:t_4:37.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The one-of-a-kind scar that days of fierce fighting carved into him...」

556:t_4:39.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The one I want isn't $$相良$$...」

556:t_4:40.en:
$$かなめ$$
「A world of cruel, merciless destruction and slaughter... The him who grew up amid the war and chaos there...」

556:t_4:43.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So I'm going home. Back to that world.」

556:t_4:45.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「You'd let him die?! Him and your mother?! It's a grave sin to abandon everyone and do nothing!」

556:t_4:46.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Even so, there's nothing... I can do anymore.」

556:t_4:47.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「There is! I'm going to play the melody of rebirth right now! Don't you dare give up!」

556:t_4:48.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「You're trying to run away right now! You're trying to throw it all away!」

556:t_4:49.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm not throwing anything away. And I haven't given up, either.」

556:t_4:50.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Even if the world is going to be destroyed one minute from now, I'll keep moving forward for that one minute... That's the very thing that has meaning.」

556:t_4:51.en:
$$かなめ$$
「He, together with his friends, as the person he is now in the world as it is now」

556:t_4:52.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What has value is the will of that self to think that way.」

556:t_4:53.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「That kind of thing is...!」

556:t_4:54.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'll go on living. In a world without him.」

556:t_4:55.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「That's nothing but self-deception! Don't you think that's selfish?!」

556:t_4:56.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「There's a way to bring the dead back to life, and you won't use it?! How can that be?!」

556:t_4:57.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Even if such a way really existed... it must be a power we're not supposed to use...」

556:t_4:58.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「And him... what about $$宗介$$?! He'll surely regret this!」

556:t_4:59.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That guy would surely accept this! Because...!」

556:t_4:60.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Because... that guy would never, ever like a me who whimpers and starts over.」

556:t_4:61.en:
$$かなめ$$
「He can't put his life on the line for a woman like that! So... so I...!」

556:t_4:63.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'll show that guy I've got guts!」

556:t_4:64.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「I'm... vanishing...... and going away.........」

556:t_4:65.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I can... live just fine without $$宗介$$ around.」

556:t_4:66.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'll forget all about you right away, find some better guy, and be so, so happy...」

556:t_5:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Draw your knife. Since we're both out of bullets, it ends in hand-to-hand combat.」

556:t_5:4.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I never thought you'd actually come after me.」

556:t_5:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「I thought I should settle this with my own hands.」

556:t_5:6.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Since when did you become such a romantic?」

556:t_5:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm under no obligation to answer.」

556:t_5:8.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「So you are prepared to be caught up in the $$時空震動|lc$$.」

556:t_5:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「I came intending, at the very least, to take you down with me. ...If you have an excuse, I'll hear it.」

556:t_5:10.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「No matter what I say, you'll be angry anyway.」

556:t_5:14.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「What's wrong? Can't lay a hand on me without an AS?」

556:t_5:16.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I've taught you how to fight, but there's something I've always thought.」

556:t_5:19.en:
$$宗介$$
(I don't need to be told that. I know it already. ...I'm no genius.)

556:t_5:20.en:
$$宗介$$
(I can't match the Major in hand-to-hand combat. As for sniping and piloting an AS, there are plenty of people better than me.)

556:t_5:23.en:
$$宗介$$
(At best, it's my tenacity when it counts!)

556:t_5:26.en:
$$宗介$$
「Your knife is broken. I win.」

556:t_5:29.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「What's wrong? Aren't you going to finish me off?」

556:t_5:31.en:
$$宗介$$
(There's no way I could kill the Major...)

556:t_5:32.en:
$$宗介$$
(To me, the Major is... my father...)

556:t_5:33.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「...That's why I told you. That you have no talent.」

556:t_5:35.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You're a lamb raised in a pack of wolves.」

556:t_5:36.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You have no hunger for blood, no need to devour flesh, yet you played the wolf... because you couldn't have survived otherwise.」

556:t_5:37.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Where is there a creature so warped and so sad?」

556:t_5:39.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You shouldn't be doing this. You should never have become the kind of man they call $$カシム$$ or $$ウルズ$$ 7.」

556:t_5:40.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「There should have been a more fitting place for you...」

556:t_5:41.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Ever since the day I pulled you out of a crashed airliner, and again when I saw you on the battlefield years later, I have thought so.」

556:t_5:45.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「...This is... my last lesson for you...」

カシム.evidence: Kalinin says Sousuke was called カシム or ウルズ７ (Kashim / Urzu 7), his Afghan-era alias in Full Metal Panic!; not in the glossary sheet
